videos.t: How to make an Evil Book Prop.
videos.desc:
Making an Evil book prop.
Some people called the book of the dead, or the Necronomicon. 
Using a hardbound sketchbook. I’m going to design some kind of creepy pattern. Then using tissue paper and some Creaturecast rubber to create the texture, ot simulate, leather or skin. Then going to paint it with some acrylic paint and Goblinshut Aging spray paint. It is a prop for an upcoming project.
